hooks.command: if [ "${DEVFLOW_CODEX_GUARD_REQUIRED:-}" != "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; denial='DevFlow guard: hook bootstrap failed; tool call blocked by policy.'; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { printf '%s\n' "$denial" >&2; exit 2; }; adapter="$root/scripts/devflow_codex_target_guard.py"; if [ ! -f "$adapter" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$denial" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec /usr/bin/env python3 "$adapter"
